text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Three days remain until Operation
Oversight is
implemented.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nutritional penalty drinks? What's that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hm... It says, "Under Operation
Oversight, all
students are required to
record the nutritional
content of
everything they eat each day."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If a student consumes too much or too
little...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All their meals of the following day will
be
replaced with 'penalty drinks,' a
beverage that is
incredibly bitter but
nutritionally dense...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nooooo!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait, we'll have to take a quiz in each class every day after Operation Oversight starts?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-and if you flunk them, you have to
take extra
classes on the weekend...
Ohhh, the stars are so
unaligned right
now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait! In times like these, I should go
recharge my
powers at my secret sacred
site!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but wait... Now we have to fill out
permission
slips to go out, and I'd have
to specify where I'm
going "for my
safety"...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: NOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This doesn't make any dang sense! Now
school's
all sad an' depressin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I prefer it when we were happy an' free
to do
whatever we wanted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other students nod their assent at
Taiki
Shuttle's impassioned outburst.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There' nothin' for it. Let's go have a li'l
word with
Ms. Kashimoto!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I happen to be passing by the director's
office
when I see Taiki Shuttle with a
group of students,
all arguing with Ms.
Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We the students are against Operation
Oversight!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
How many times must I repeat myself? I
will not
change my decision.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
B-but... I hate seein' everyone at school
so down
in the dumps!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Things were way better back when we
could all
have ice cream for a midnight
snack and enjoy
tasty foods without
worryin' 'bout nothin'!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And having quizzes every day is just too
much! It's
worse than torture!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You students are so persistent, coming
to bother
me every day... Do you have
any idea how many
of you have come to
complain to me today?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
And it's always the same indulgent
requests. To
respect your
"independence" or reinstate the
Unity
Cup... How tiresome.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That said, I can hardly expect the new
system to
yield results while this dogged
resistance
continues. As such...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Students, I propose a small wager with
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The challenge Ms. Kashimoto suggests
sends
shockwaves throughout the
student body.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To defeat a team trained by Ms.
Kashimoto in the
Unity Cup...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I shall put my decision to ban the Unity
Cup on
hold for now.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I shall refrain from
enforcing
Operation Oversight until the
Unity Cup is over.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Strive to defeat Team Zenith, a team I will be assembling and personally training with my methods, in the Unity Cup.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If you succeed in this task, I will call off

Operation Oversight.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If you fail, however, then I shall proceed
with the
implementation of my new
system accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
These are quite generous terms, don't
you agree?
All you need to do is win,
thereby proving that
your methods truly
are superior to mine.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...But if the students can't defeat Ms.
Kashimoto's
team, she will have proven
that her methods were
right all along.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This must be her way of silencing any
arguments
against her ironfisted
management once and for
all...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume Ms. Kashimoto selects
after
making her announcement are truly
elite runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One of them is Bitter Glasse, a fiendishly
strong
Umamusume who loves
competition. She often
talks about the
importance of being gutsy.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's a good weight! Time to
gooo!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Guts! Glory! And gumptiooon!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passerby
text_block_list.text: What's with her?! How is she able to sprint while dragging that massive tire behind her?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Also among their number is Little Cocon,
a
cynical Umamusume whose lung
capacity is truly
unparallelled.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Wait, I've heard of her before...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about her. Your break is
over in five
minutes, so hurry to the
pool.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With these two standout athletes at its
forefront,
Ms. Kashimoto puts together a
team of
exceptional racers who agree
with her totalitarian
management
methods.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the brief period since Director
Akikawa
announced her temporary leave
of absence,
Tracen Academy has already
descended into
chaos.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I got in touch with Director Akikawa, but
it seems
she's too busy to return for the
time being.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
There's one other thing, though... She
also said
that it's too early to consider
this a crisis.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Director Akikawa knows the academy
better than
anyone, so she can probably
see things others
can't.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't think things are dire, then
let's just
do what we can do here on our
own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the circumstances, Ms.
Kashimoto's
methods are far too
overbearing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't simply sit back and watch as she
snatches
away all the freedoms the
students have enjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This stays between us and is strictly off
the
record, but... please win this,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I agree that some oversight is necessary
for the
students. It would be
irresponsible if they incurred
injuries or
illness due to lack of supervision...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But I cannot in good conscience approve
of Ms.
Kashimoto's overly restrictive and
repressive
methods.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I much prefer seeing Tracen Academy
filled with
beaming faces than tension.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tazuna smiles at me, and I give her an

encouraging nod in response.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First things first, I need to assemble a
team. Then,
we'll have to work together
to defeat Team
Zenith!
